funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.hint: Each job counts once in every step it reached (and the earlier ones). The percentage is the conversion from the previous step.
funnel.caption: Jobs per funnel step

week.title: By week
week.hint: Week the job was seen (Monday to Sunday, Madrid time).
week.label: Week of {{date}} ({{week}})
week.caption: Jobs per week
week.head: Week

response.title: First reply
response.hint: From sending to the first reply, interview, test, offer or rejection.
response.none: You haven't sent any application in this period yet.

reasons.title: Discard reasons
reasons.hint: Jobs per reason; a job can fail several filters at once.
reasons.noFilters: No closures by filters in this period.

bySource.title: By source
bySource.hint: Where the jobs that move forward come from.
bySource.caption: Funnel by source
bySource.head: Source

byTitle.title: By role type
byTitle.hint: Normalized title from the extraction; the least frequent go into “Others”.
byTitle.caption: Funnel by role type
byTitle.head: Role

byReferral.title: By referral
byReferral.hint: Whether a contact in the process gave you a referral, or you only asked for one. You mark it on the job page.
byReferral.caption: Funnel by referral
byReferral.head: Referral

calibration.title: Is the score right?
calibration.hint: Reply and interview rates of the applications you sent (in the chosen period, by sending date) based on what you knew when you sent them.
calibration.note: Indicative. In brackets, the 95% interval: if two groups' intervals overlap, there's no clear difference. Weights and filters don't change on their own: your agent proposes and you decide, checking with cai eval matching.
calibration.none: You haven't sent any application in this period yet. It makes sense from about {{min}}-30 sent.
calibration.caution: · with fewer than {{min}}, take it with a big pinch of salt
calibration.caption: Calibration by {{tab}}

score.label: Score
score.hint: The job's score when you sent it.

verdict.label: Verdict
verdict.hint: The agent's assessment before sending it.

platform.label: Job board
platform.hint: The job's job board, if known.

letter.label: Letter
letter.hint: Whether there was a cover letter when sending.

referral.label: Referral
referral.hint: Whether a contact in the process gave you a referral or you asked for one.

days.label: Speed
days.hint: Days between the job coming in and you sending it.
